projects.createHint: A project gathers documents from any folder, with notes and a reading plan.
projects.noMembers: Add documents from the library to read them together, plan the reading and take notes.

projects.removed_other: {{count}} documents removed from the project (the files are untouched).

kindHint.project: Project: documents, notes and a reading plan.
kindHint.collection: Collection: just a set of documents.

projects.archivedNoAdd: An archived project cannot take documents. Restore it first.
projects.addTooMany: A project can hold at most {{limit}} documents; this one would have {{n}}.

bib.copied: BibTeX references copied to the clipboard ({{count}}).

state.changed-outside: The .bib file was changed outside the app: it is not rewritten.
state.error: The file {{file}} could not be written.

plan.hint: Drag a row, press Alt+Up or Alt+Down on it, or use the arrows to reorder.
plan.empty: The plan is empty. Add documents of the project below.
plan.addAll: Add all {{count}} documents not in the plan

schema.question: Question {{n}}
schema.noClaims: No claim · in the reader: click a highlight › Use as evidence
schema.emptyIdea: Write the idea of the research in a few lines.
schema.emptyEvidence: Link highlights to questions: in the reader: click a highlight › Use as evidence
schema.invite: Write the research outline: idea, questions, hypotheses, plan.
schema.capReached: The daily token cap is reached: nothing is sent.

report.needOutline: The project needs its research outline: write it from the Notes tab ("Write it now").
report.title: Report for the period
report.what: The outline, the notes and the activity of the period are sent (titles and excerpts; never the PDFs).
report.ready: Draft ✦ of {{date}}: you can edit it

cite.title: Suggest citations
cite.noParagraph: No paragraph to cover in the notes of the project.
cite.consentText: Your paragraphs are unpublished text and are not covered by the consent of the folders. To go on, allow Claude to receive the paragraphs of this project, one at a time and always after you have seen the exact text. You can revoke the consent at any time.
cite.consentRevoke: Revoke the consent of this project
cite.what: This paragraph goes out with {{count}} candidates found in your library.
cite.noCandidates: No candidate in the library for this paragraph.
cite.none: No convincing candidate for this paragraph.

evidence.title: Use as evidence
evidence.noProject: There is no project yet: create one from Projects.
evidence.addMember: Add the document to the project
evidence.saved: Evidence saved in the outline of the project.

prisma.title: PRISMA flow diagram · {{name}}
prisma.hint: Counted by the app while you extend the bibliography of this project. Steps done outside the app can be typed under "Edit counts".
prisma.hintEdited: Some counts were typed by you for steps done outside the app.
